title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Integrated Towel Bar Solid Brass | Fire Engine Red | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a wall mount glass shelf that adds a 16 x 5 inch surface and an integrated towel bar in one streamlined piece in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space.

  • Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Strong glass: 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with a beveled edge
  • Solid brass hardware: crafted from solid brass materials for durable support
  • Coordinated look: part of the Waverly Place Collection for matching accessories

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Projection: 5 Inches
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Multiple designer finish options available

_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, traditional style glass shelf. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Waverly Place Collection, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom décor.
